LABEL.CS_10_1_1_ELISABETH_1: Öksürük, öksürük! Bu nasil bir oda?

LABEL.CS_10_1_1_ARTHUR_1: Burasi Beyler Sigara Salonu. Bu mobilyayi hareket ettirmemiz gerekiyor.

LABEL.CS_10_1_2_ELISABETH_1: Araliktan geçmemiz gerekiyor. Su perdeyi yakalayabilsem, belki baston ise yarar.

LABEL.CS_10_1_3_ELISABETH_1: Tamam, bu oldu sanirim. Hadi buradan çikalim!

LABEL.CS_10_2_1_ELISABETH_1: Oh, basardik. Sanirim bu veda vakti, Arthur. En azindan simdilik.

LABEL.CS_10_2_1_ARTHUR_1: Iyi sanslar hanimefendi, sizinle tanistigima çok sevindim. Jacob'a iyi bakin. Hosça kal oglum, seni çok sevdigimi ve her zaman seni gözetecegimi lütfen unutma.

LABEL.CS_10_2_1_ELISABETH_2: Bir saniye - adin Jacob mu? Benim dedemin adi da Jacob'du. Elimi tut Jacob ve sakin birakma! Babaniza sana bakacagima söz verdim, bunu yapacagim!

LABEL.CS_10_2_1_JACOB_2: Kurtulabilecek mi? Neden filikalari doldurmuyorlar? O filikada sadece 12 kisi var, en az 40 kisi tasimalari gerekmiyor muydu?

LABEL.CS_10_2_1_ELISABETH_3: Onlar Titanic orkestrasi ve en son ana kadar o müzigi çalmaya devam edecekler...

LABEL.CS_10_2_1_CREWMAN_2: Filika sikisti. Halatlarindan kurtarmaya yardimci olacak bir sey bulmamiz gerekiyor.

LABEL.CS_10_2_2_ELISABETH_1: Biliyorum Jacob, ama kürek çekmeye baslamamiz gerekiyor. Titanic hizla batiyor ve buradan uzaklasmazsak filikalar da onunla birlikte suya çekilecek. Hadi herkes, kürek çekelim!

LABEL.CS_10_3_1_PASSENGER2_1: Neden kimse bizi kurtarmaya gelmiyor? Simdi her yer çok sessiz ve Titanic'in isiklari söndü.

LABEL.CS_10_3_1_PASSENGER2_2: Hava çok soguk, sudaki o insanlari düsünmeye dayanamiyorum.

LABEL.CS_10_3_1_ELISABETH_2: Herkes ceplerine ve filikada etrafimiza baksin. Bizi sicak tutacak yiyecek ve battaniye ne varsa toplayin.

LABEL.CS_10_3_2_ELISABETH_1: Cebimdeki de ne, bir not gibi görünüyor?

LABEL.CS_10_3_3_ELISABETH_1: Bu kolyeyi artik istemiyorum. Bana ve sevdigim herkese ugursuzluktan baska bir sey getirmedi.

LABEL.CS_10_3_4_EVE_1: Ben neredeyim? Gemi nerede? Batiyor muyuz? Çocuklar iyi mi?

LABEL.CS_10_3_4_EVE_2: Gerçekten Titanic'te miydim, yoksa her sey sadece bir rüya miydi?

LABEL.CS_10_3_4_LIAM_1: Çok garip davraniyorsun anne. Gemimize hiçbir sey olmadi. Bosuna 'Invincible' demiyorlar. Titanic'in hayaletleriyle ilgili bir film izleyecegiz, bizimle gelip izlemek ister misin?

LABEL.CS_10_3_4_EVE_3: Hayir tesekkürler. Sanirim simdiden fazlasiyla Titanic hayaleti gördüm. Ayrica bugün bakmam gereken bazi bilgiler var

LABEL.CS_10_3_5_EVE_1: Burada Elizabeth ile Jacob'un Titanic'in batisindan sag kurtuldugu yaziyor. Carpathia'da Titanic kurtulanlari olarak listelenmisler ve 18 Nisan 1912'de New York'a varmislar. Elizabeth daha sonra Jacob'u evlat edinip onu kendi oglu gibi büyütmüs. Arthur'un cesedi hiç bulunamamis ve gemiye bindigine dair hiçbir kayit da yokmus; gerçi bunu zaten biliyordum.

LABEL.CS_10_3_5_EVE_2: Annemin, babasinin yani dedem Jacob'un gerçek kökenini bana neden hiç anlatmadigini merak ediyorum. Elizabeth gerçekten hayranlik uyandiran bir kadindi ve Jacob da çok cesur bir küçük çocuktu. Onunla ve babasiyla, sadece rüyalarimda da olsa, tanisabildigime sevindim...

LABEL.CS_10_1_1_ELISABETH_1: Cough, cough! What kind of a room is this?

LABEL.CS_10_1_1_ARTHUR_1: It's the Gentleman's Smoking Room. We need to move this furniture.

LABEL.CS_10_1_2_ELISABETH_1: We need to go through the gap. If I could just grab that curtain, maybe the walking stick will help.

LABEL.CS_10_1_3_ELISABETH_1: Ok, that should do it. Let's get out of here!

LABEL.CS_10_2_1_ELISABETH_1: Phew, we made it. I guess this is goodbye, Arthur. For now, anyway.

LABEL.CS_10_2_1_ARTHUR_1: Good luck, Miss, I'm so glad that I met you. Take good care of Jacob. Goodbye my son, please know that I love you very much and will always be watching over you.

LABEL.CS_10_2_1_ELISABETH_2: Hang on a second - your name is Jacob? My grandfather was called Jacob. Hold on to my hand Jacob and never let go! I promised your father I'd take care of you and I will!

LABEL.CS_10_2_1_JACOB_2: Will he make it? Why aren't they filling the lifeboats? There are only 12 people in that boat, I thought they were supposed to carry at least 40 people?

LABEL.CS_10_2_1_JACOB_3: Those men are playing music, why?

LABEL.CS_10_2_1_ELISABETH_3: That's the Titanic band, and they will carry on playing that music until the very end...

LABEL.CS_10_2_1_CREWMAN_2: The lifeboat is stuck. We need to find something to help release it from its ropes.

LABEL.CS_10_2_2_JACOB_1: I'm scared Elizabeth. I'm scared for my Papa.

LABEL.CS_10_2_2_ELISABETH_1: I know Jacob, but we need to start rowing. The Titanic is sinking fast and the lifeboats will get sucked down with her if we don't move away from here. Come on everybody, let's row!

LABEL.CS_10_3_1_PASSENGER2_1: Why is no one coming to save us? It is so quiet now and the lights on the Titanic have gone out.

LABEL.CS_10_3_1_ELISABETH_1: They'll be along soon, I promise.

LABEL.CS_10_3_1_PASSENGER2_2: It is so cold, I cannot bear to think of those people in the water.

LABEL.CS_10_3_1_ELISABETH_2: Everyone look in your pockets and around us in the boat. Gather any food and blankets that will keep us warm.

LABEL.CS_10_3_2_ELISABETH_1: What's this in my pocket, it looks like a note?

LABEL.CS_10_3_3_ELISABETH_1: I don't want this necklace anymore. It's brought nothing but bad luck to me and everyone I love.

LABEL.CS_10_3_4_THOMAS_1: Eva, wake up, you passed out hours ago!

LABEL.CS_10_3_4_EVE_1: Where am I? Where's the ship? Are we sinking? Are the children ok?

LABEL.CS_10_3_4_BECKY_1: We're fine, mum - are you ok?

LABEL.CS_10_3_4_EVE_2: Was I really on the Titanic, or was it all just a dream?

LABEL.CS_10_3_4_LIAM_1: You're acting very strange, mum. Nothing happened to our ship. It's called 'Invincible' for a reason. We're going to watch a film about the ghosts of Titanic, do you want to come see it with us?

LABEL.CS_10_3_4_EVE_3: No thanks. I think I have seen a few too many Titanic ghosts already. Besides, there is some information that I need to look for today

LABEL.CS_10_3_5_EVE_1: It says here that Elizabeth and Jacob survived the sinking of the Titanic. They're listed as Titanic survivors, aboard the Carpathia, and arrived in New York on the 18th April 1912. Elizabeth later adopted Jacob to raise him as her own son. Arthur's body was never found and there were no records of him boarding the ship, although I knew that already.

LABEL.CS_10_3_5_EVE_2: I wonder why my mother never told me about the true heritage of her father and my grandfather, Jacob. Elizabeth truly was an admirable woman and Jacob such a brave young boy. I'm glad I got to meet him and his father even if only in my dreams...
